content.user_title: Draft Belgian VME Meeting and Finance Documents
content.value_statement: Belgian co-ownership managers must prepare documents with accurate meeting procedures and financial details. This guide helps AI assistants draft VME documents for legal and factual review.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting of meeting invitations with notice periods and agenda items.
Supports agenda drafts with proposed voting majority requirements.
Guides meeting minutes with vote tables and named dissenters.
Supports account summaries separating working capital from reserve capital.
Provides context for reserve contribution calculations and overdue contribution notices.
Supports Dutch or English document drafting through an AI assistant.
limitations: The reviewed folder contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, and document templates are absent.
Legal compliance, current statutory accuracy, and automatic legal updates are not verified by this guide.
Users must supply property details, ownership shares, financial figures, and meeting records.
Guidance focuses on Belgian Civil Code Book 3 and does not replace professional advice for complex disputes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a General Meeting
use_cases.description: Draft invitations and agenda items, with proposed majority requirements for review before distribution.

use_cases.title: Record Co-owner Decisions
use_cases.description: Turn supplied attendance and voting records into draft minutes with dissenters and unresolved details clearly identified.

use_cases.title: Organize Annual Account Notes
use_cases.description: Prepare draft account summaries that separate working and reserve capital using supplied figures.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Meeting Invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Dutch VME meeting invitation for [property] on [date] with [agenda items]. Mark missing information and flag notice-period checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare an initial invitation draft.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Agenda Item
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an agenda item about [proposed works]. Suggest the voting majority and legal basis, stating assumptions and points requiring legal verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a decision for discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Voting Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft English VME minutes from [attendance, shares, motions, and votes]. Include a vote table and named dissenters; flag missing data without inventing it.

prompt_templates.title: Review Accounts and Reserve Funding
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [annual figures and property details], draft an account summary separating working and reserve capital. Explain the reserve contribution calculation, assumptions, and legal checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare financial documentation for professional review.

output_examples.input: Draft an invitation outline for a VME meeting about roof repairs; the date and location are not yet supplied.
output: Meeting date and location: to be confirmed.
Agenda: discuss roof repairs, review quotations, and decide on funding.
Before distribution: confirm the applicable notice period, agenda wording, and proxy arrangements.

output_examples.input: Create a minutes outline for a repair motion without attendance or vote totals.
output: Motion: approve the proposed repair works.
Attendance and represented shares: not provided.
Votes for, against, and abstaining: not provided.
Named dissenters: record from the actual vote.
Decision status: cannot be established until quorum, voting records, and the applicable majority are checked.

best_practices: Provide complete property details, ownership shares, meeting dates, and verified financial figures.
Verify legal references, majority requirements, and notice periods against current law before using drafts.
Minimize personal data in prompts and review names, votes, amounts, and recipients before distribution.
anti_patterns: Treating generated drafts as guaranteed legally binding or compliant documents.
Inventing missing votes, ownership shares, account balances, or statutory references.
Expecting this public guide to include paid templates, executable automation, or guaranteed legal updates.

faq.question: What does the reviewed folder include?
faq.answer: It includes one SKILL.md public guide. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Which document languages are described?
faq.answer: The guide describes drafting in Dutch and English. Review terminology and applicable language requirements before distribution.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. Generated text requires factual checks and review against current Belgian law, especially for disputed decisions.

faq.question: What information must I provide?
faq.answer: Provide relevant property details, ownership shares, meeting records, financial figures, and the intended document language.

faq.question: Are legal updates or accounting software included?
faq.answer: No update mechanism or accounting software is included in this folder. Statements about paid package benefits do not establish included functionality.

faq.question: Can I use this guide with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists these tools as supported. The guide provides drafting context rather than executable integrations.
